quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported Yes/No Question
quests.directSpeech: The recruiter asked, "Would you be willing to relocate for this role?"
quests.reportedSpeech: The recruiter asked whether I would be willing to relocate for that role.
changesList: question word order → statement word order
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Would' stays the same since it's already a past-time form; 'this' becomes 'that', and inversion is removed.
quests.nativeTip: 'Would' stays the same since it's already a past-time form — focus on the demonstrative and the word order.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The recruiter asked, "Would you be willing to relocate for this role?"" ➔ "The recruiter asked whether I would be willing to relocate for that role."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Backshift Exception
quests.directSpeech: The nurse asked, "Might you be allergic to any medications?"
quests.reportedSpeech: The nurse asked whether I might be allergic to any medications.
changesList: question word order → statement word order
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Might' stays the same, 'you' becomes 'I', and the question order becomes a statement.
quests.nativeTip: 'Might' stays unchanged — remove the inversion and update the pronoun.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The nurse asked, "Might you be allergic to any medications?"" ➔ "The nurse asked whether I might be allergic to any medications."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: The consultant asked, "Should the company invest in new equipment this year?"
quests.reportedSpeech: The consultant asked whether the company should invest in new equipment that year.
changesList: question word order → statement word order
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Should' stays the same, and 'this year' becomes 'that year'.
quests.nativeTip: 'Should' doesn't change, but the time word and word order do.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The consultant asked, "Should the company invest in new equipment this year?"" ➔ "The consultant asked whether the company should invest in new equipment that year."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: The manager asked, "Why did sales drop even though we increased advertising?"
quests.reportedSpeech: The manager asked why sales had dropped even though they had increased advertising.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Did drop' becomes 'had dropped', and 'we increased' becomes 'they had increased', matching the earlier completed actions.
quests.nativeTip: Both clauses in this question backshift, and the pronoun in the second clause changes too.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The manager asked, "Why did sales drop even though we increased advertising?"" ➔ "The manager asked why sales had dropped even though they had increased advertising."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: The teacher asked, "How can you improve if you don't practice?"
quests.reportedSpeech: The teacher asked how I could improve if I didn't practice.
changesList: question word order → statement word order
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Can' becomes 'could', 'don't' becomes 'didn't', and 'you' becomes 'I' throughout.
quests.nativeTip: Backshift the modal and the conditional clause, and update both pronouns.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The teacher asked, "How can you improve if you don't practice?"" ➔ "The teacher asked how I could improve if I didn't practice."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: The detective asked, "Where were you when the alarm went off?"
quests.reportedSpeech: The detective asked where I had been when the alarm had gone off.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Were' becomes 'had been', and 'went off' becomes 'had gone off'; 'you' becomes 'I'.
quests.nativeTip: Both the main verb and the verb in the time clause backshift one more step.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The detective asked, "Where were you when the alarm went off?"" ➔ "The detective asked where I had been when the alarm had gone off."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported Yes/No Question
quests.directSpeech: The auditor asked, "Aren't these figures inconsistent with last quarter's report?"
quests.reportedSpeech: The auditor asked whether those figures weren't inconsistent with the previous quarter's report.
changesList: question word order → statement word order
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Aren't' becomes 'weren't', 'these' becomes 'those', and 'last quarter's' becomes 'the previous quarter's'.
quests.nativeTip: Keep the negative meaning, and update the demonstrative and time reference.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The auditor asked, "Aren't these figures inconsistent with last quarter's report?"" ➔ "The auditor asked whether those figures weren't inconsistent with the previous quarter's report."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported Yes/No Question
quests.directSpeech: Layla asked, "Haven't you finished packing yet?"
quests.reportedSpeech: Layla asked whether I hadn't finished packing yet.
changesList: question word order → statement word order
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Haven't finished' becomes 'hadn't finished', and 'you' becomes 'I'.
quests.nativeTip: Negative present perfect backshifts the same way positive present perfect does.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Layla asked, "Haven't you finished packing yet?"" ➔ "Layla asked whether I hadn't finished packing yet."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported Yes/No Question
quests.directSpeech: The editor asked, "Wasn't this article supposed to be shorter?"
quests.reportedSpeech: The editor asked whether that article wasn't supposed to be shorter.
changesList: question word order → statement word order
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Wasn't' stays as 'wasn't' since it's already past tense, and 'this' becomes 'that'.
quests.nativeTip: Keep the negative form of 'was', and update the demonstrative.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The editor asked, "Wasn't this article supposed to be shorter?"" ➔ "The editor asked whether that article wasn't supposed to be shorter."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reporting Verb Pattern
quests.directSpeech: Santiago said to himself, "Did I lock the front door?"
quests.reportedSpeech: Santiago wondered whether he had locked the front door.
quests.ruleExplanation: Since Santiago is questioning himself, 'wondered' fits better than 'asked'; 'did lock' becomes 'had locked'.
quests.nativeTip: A question someone asks themselves, silently, is best reported with 'wondered'.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Santiago said to himself, "Did I lock the front door?"" ➔ "Santiago wondered whether he had locked the front door."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reporting Verb Pattern
quests.directSpeech: The journalist said, "What evidence do you have for these claims?"
quests.reportedSpeech: The journalist demanded to know what evidence I had for those claims.
quests.ruleExplanation: The confrontational tone matches 'demanded to know', and 'these' becomes 'those'.
quests.nativeTip: A forceful, challenging question like this can be reported with 'demanded to know' instead of a plain 'asked'.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The journalist said, "What evidence do you have for these claims?"" ➔ "The journalist demanded to know what evidence I had for those claims."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reporting Verb Pattern
quests.directSpeech: The receptionist asked, "Could you confirm your appointment time?"
quests.reportedSpeech: The receptionist inquired whether I could confirm my appointment time.
changesList: question word order → statement word order
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Inquired' suits the polite, formal tone here just as well as 'asked'; 'your' becomes 'my'.
quests.nativeTip: A polite, formal request for information like this can be reported with 'inquired'.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The receptionist asked, "Could you confirm your appointment time?"" ➔ "The receptionist inquired whether I could confirm my appointment time."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: The doctor asked, "How long have you been feeling this way?"
quests.reportedSpeech: The doctor asked how long I had been feeling that way.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Have been feeling' becomes 'had been feeling', and 'this way' becomes 'that way'.
quests.nativeTip: Present perfect continuous backshifts to past perfect continuous, plus a demonstrative change.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The doctor asked, "How long have you been feeling this way?"" ➔ "The doctor asked how long I had been feeling that way."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: The manager asked, "How long has the team been working on this project?"
quests.reportedSpeech: The manager asked how long the team had been working on that project.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Has been working' becomes 'had been working', and 'this' becomes 'that'.
quests.nativeTip: No pronoun to change here — just the perfect continuous tense and the demonstrative.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The manager asked, "How long has the team been working on this project?"" ➔ "The manager asked how long the team had been working on that project."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: The landlord asked, "Have you been paying your utility bills on time?"
quests.reportedSpeech: The landlord asked whether I had been paying my utility bills on time.
changesList: question word order → statement word order
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Have been paying' becomes 'had been paying', 'you' becomes 'I', and 'your' becomes 'my'.
quests.nativeTip: Combine the perfect continuous backshift with the possessive and pronoun changes.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The landlord asked, "Have you been paying your utility bills on time?"" ➔ "The landlord asked whether I had been paying my utility bills on time."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Indirect-to-Direct Reconstruction
quests.directSpeech: The recruiter asked whether I would be willing to relocate for that role.
quests.reportedSpeech: The recruiter asked, "Would you be willing to relocate for this role?"
quests.ruleExplanation: 'That' reverses to 'this', and 'I' reverses to 'you'; 'would' remains unchanged.
quests.nativeTip: Reverse the demonstrative and pronoun; 'would' stays the same since it doesn't reverse any further.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The recruiter asked whether I would be willing to relocate for that role." ➔ "The recruiter asked, "Would you be willing to relocate for this role?""

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Indirect-to-Direct Reconstruction
quests.directSpeech: The doctor asked how long I had been feeling that way.
quests.reportedSpeech: The doctor asked, "How long have you been feeling this way?"
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Had been feeling' reverses to 'have been feeling', 'that way' reverses to 'this way', and 'I' reverses to 'you'.
quests.nativeTip: Reverse the past perfect continuous to present perfect continuous, and reverse the demonstrative and pronoun.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The doctor asked how long I had been feeling that way." ➔ "The doctor asked, "How long have you been feeling this way?""

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Indirect-to-Direct Reconstruction
quests.directSpeech: The auditor asked whether those figures weren't inconsistent with the previous quarter's report.
quests.reportedSpeech: The auditor asked, "Aren't these figures inconsistent with last quarter's report?"
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Weren't' reverses to 'aren't', 'those' reverses to 'these', and 'the previous quarter's' reverses to 'last quarter's'.
quests.nativeTip: Keep the negative meaning intact, and reverse the demonstrative and time expression.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The auditor asked whether those figures weren't inconsistent with the previous quarter's report." ➔ "The auditor asked, "Aren't these figures inconsistent with last quarter's report?""

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: Nadia asked, "Why did you tell them my secret?"
quests.reportedSpeech: Nadia asked why I had told them her secret.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Did tell' becomes 'had told', 'you' becomes 'I', and 'my' becomes 'her'; 'them' stays the same since it refers to a third group.
quests.nativeTip: Three pronoun-type words change here: the subject, the possessive, and the tense.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Nadia asked, "Why did you tell them my secret?"" ➔ "Nadia asked why I had told them her secret."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: The manager asked, "Who gave you permission to leave early?"
quests.reportedSpeech: The manager asked who had given me permission to leave early.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Gave' backshifts to 'had given', and 'you' becomes 'me'.
quests.nativeTip: 'Who' as the subject means no word-order change, but the verb and object pronoun still shift.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The manager asked, "Who gave you permission to leave early?"" ➔ "The manager asked who had given me permission to leave early."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: Fatima asked, "What did he tell you about our plans?"
quests.reportedSpeech: Fatima asked what he had told me about their plans.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Did tell' becomes 'had told', 'you' becomes 'me', and 'our' becomes 'their'.
quests.nativeTip: Three separate items change: the tense, one pronoun, and the possessive.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Fatima asked, "What did he tell you about our plans?"" ➔ "Fatima asked what he had told me about their plans."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: The teacher said, "I noticed you were distracted. What's going on?"
quests.reportedSpeech: The teacher said that she had noticed I was distracted and asked what was going on.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Noticed' becomes 'had noticed', 'you' becomes 'I', and 'what's going on' becomes 'what was going on'.
quests.nativeTip: This combines a reported statement and a reported question in one item — treat each part separately.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The teacher said, "I noticed you were distracted. What's going on?"" ➔ "The teacher said that she had noticed I was distracted and asked what was going on."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: Kenji said, "I'm running late. Can you start the meeting without me?"
quests.reportedSpeech: Kenji said that he was running late and asked whether they could start the meeting without him.
changesList: question word order → statement word order
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Am running' becomes 'was running', 'you' becomes 'they', 'can' becomes 'could', and 'me' becomes 'him'.
quests.nativeTip: First backshift the statement, then convert the question into statement word order too.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Kenji said, "I'm running late. Can you start the meeting without me?"" ➔ "Kenji said that he was running late and asked whether they could start the meeting without him."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: The client said, "I received the invoice. Is the total amount correct?"
quests.reportedSpeech: The client said that she had received the invoice and asked whether the total amount was correct.
changesList: question word order → statement word order
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Received' becomes 'had received', and 'is' becomes 'was'; the question order becomes a statement.
quests.nativeTip: Handle the statement and the question as two separate transformations joined together.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The client said, "I received the invoice. Is the total amount correct?"" ➔ "The client said that she had received the invoice and asked whether the total amount was correct."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reporting Verb Pattern
quests.directSpeech: Priya thought to herself, "Should I take this opportunity?"
quests.reportedSpeech: Priya wondered whether she should take that opportunity.
changesList: question word order → statement word order
quests.ruleExplanation: Since this is an internal thought, 'wondered' fits better than 'asked'; 'this' becomes 'that'.
quests.nativeTip: A silent question to oneself is naturally reported with 'wondered', not 'asked'.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Priya thought to herself, "Should I take this opportunity?"" ➔ "Priya wondered whether she should take that opportunity."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: Idris asked himself, "Why does this always happen to me?"
quests.reportedSpeech: Idris wondered why that always happened to him.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Wondered' matches a self-directed question, 'this' becomes 'that', 'happens' becomes 'happened', and 'me' becomes 'him'.
quests.nativeTip: Combine the reporting-verb choice with the demonstrative, tense, and pronoun changes.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Idris asked himself, "Why does this always happen to me?"" ➔ "Idris wondered why that always happened to him."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reporting Verb Pattern
quests.directSpeech: Isabella thought, "Is it too late to apologize?"
quests.reportedSpeech: Isabella wondered whether it was too late to apologize.
changesList: question word order → statement word order
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Is' backshifts to 'was', and word order becomes a statement; 'wondered' matches the reflective tone of the original thought.
quests.nativeTip: This internal reflection is best captured with 'wondered', matching its reflective tone.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Isabella thought, "Is it too late to apologize?"" ➔ "Isabella wondered whether it was too late to apologize."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: The panel asked, "Why should we choose you over other candidates?"
quests.reportedSpeech: The panel asked why they should choose me over other candidates.
changesList: question word order → statement word order
quests.ruleExplanation: 'We' becomes 'they', 'you' becomes 'me', and the question order becomes a statement; 'should' remains unchanged.
quests.nativeTip: 'Should' stays the same, but the pronouns and word order still change.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The panel asked, "Why should we choose you over other candidates?"" ➔ "The panel asked why they should choose me over other candidates."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: Adaeze wondered, "Have I made the right decision?"
quests.reportedSpeech: Adaeze wondered whether she had made the right decision.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Wondered' fits this reflective, self-directed question, and 'have made' becomes 'had made'.
quests.nativeTip: This item checks the reporting-verb choice along with the tense backshift.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Adaeze wondered, "Have I made the right decision?"" ➔ "Adaeze wondered whether she had made the right decision."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Indirect-to-Direct Reconstruction
quests.directSpeech: The client asked whether the team could deliver the results by the following month.
quests.reportedSpeech: The client asked, "Can the team deliver the results by next month?"
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Could' reverses to 'can', and 'the following month' reverses to 'next month'.
quests.nativeTip: This final question in the section reverses the modal and the time expression back to direct speech.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The client asked whether the team could deliver the results by the following month." ➔ "The client asked, "Can the team deliver the results by next month?""
